body:
Kept the accepted one-call reclamation contract and exact-handle authority, and made its cost explicit in the [guide](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6/TreeDB/docs/guides/typed-row-store.md#L164-L173), [lifecycle specification](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6/TreeDB/docs/spec/r1-row-lifecycle.md#L250-L264) and [source lock boundary](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6/TreeDB/db/leaf_manifest_revision_gc.go#L55-L63). The complete call holds writer/snapshot-admission locks; every batch rescans and validates the full retained inventory. Worst-case O(N²/16) work remains, and footprint admission limits are not cumulative I/O or pause quotas.

The total GC-owned child descriptor bound includes link validation:16 selected handles +1 scan child or quarantine placeholder +1 temporary validation child=18; existing parent/manager/process descriptors are separate. The sampled descriptor count is not a global peak. Capping batches, releasing those locks, reusing stale numeric identity or skipping full validation would change the accepted protection/completion contract, so this patch does not adopt those alternatives. Actual finite sustained D measurements remain required to qualify maintenance cost and physical retention; the descriptor repair alone does not accept capacity or latency.
